regime_context: The detector shows a narrowing AI-hardware leadership structure (eligibility frac 0.43, absorption 0.31) that is NOT one-narrative-dominant, with AI Infrastructure leading and Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) as crowded challenger. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg and it helps here (gate_helps true), so this is a trend-discipline/vol-aware lens, not a return forecast — cross-sectional rank has ~no edge and rotation timing is display-only.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the crowded Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) theme stops making new relative highs versus AI Infrastructure — a confirmed handoff (AI Infra widening its score margin past ~0.55 while WFE breadth drops below ~0.8) would retire this watch and mark genuine leadership rotation.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Among eligible semiconductor themes, Memory/HBM shows the cleanest trend-health signature: hurst_tag 'trend' with durability_bar 0.66 and no crowding flag (z 0.22). It ranks behind AI Infra and WFE on score, but those are either broad or crowded; HBM's trend-read plus non-crowded positioning supports a modest continuation lean with the validated absolute-trend gate in effect.
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.5 — half the constituents are not participating, so the trend is narrow and could roll over quickly if a single large name stalls.

falsifier.text: SMH (proxy) lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity shows strong breadth (1.0) and trend tag, but crowding_z 1.91 is the most extended flag in the eligible set. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade — so the accountable expression is to avoid adding here rather than express a short or underweight view.
theses.dissent: Full breadth plus high durability could mean the trend persists precisely because sentiment hasn't turned; avoiding a strong-trend theme risks missing continuation.

falsifier.text: CIBR sustains its leadership (does not lag SPY by 5%+) through the 20-day window

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy Complex is the highest-ranked non-tech eligible theme (rank 7), with hurst 'trend', no crowding (z 0.68), and durability 0.61. In a narrowing-rotation environment dominated by AI hardware, a non-crowded trend outside the dominant cohort offers a diversification lean with the absolute-trend gate as the only validated edge.
theses.dissent: Breadth is very low at 0.364 — leadership is concentrated in a few names, so the theme could fade if one large holding reverses.

falsifier.text: XLE lags the S&P 500 by more than 5% before the 20-day check-by date
